options.name: delete_previous
options.description: Deletes previous nmon files with the same name before creating the new one.

options.name: disklist
options.description: Specifies a list of disks to be recorded.

options.name: disks_per_line
options.description: Specifies the number of disks to list on each line.

options.name: file_containing_disk_groups
options.description: Specifies the file that contains the user-defined disk groups. Each line in the file begins with a group name. The list of disks follows the group name and is separated with spaces. A disk can belong to various disk groups, the file can contain a maximum of 64 disk groups

options.name: filename
options.description: Specifies that the output is in spreadsheet format and the name of the output file is I(filename)

options.name: include_async
options.description: Includes the Asynchronous I/O section in the view.

options.name: include_disk_service_time
options.description: Includes the Disk Service Time section in the view.

options.name: include_disk_vg_section
options.description: Includes disk volume group section.

options.name: include_fibre_channel_section
options.description: Includes the Fibre Channel (FC) sections.

options.name: include_large_page_analysis
options.description: Includes the large page analysis section.

options.name: include_mempages_section
options.description: Includes the MEMPAGES section in the recording file. The MEMPAGES section displays detailed memory statistics per page size.

options.name: include_nfs_section
options.description: Includes the NFS section in the recording file

options.name: include_nfsv4_section
options.description: Includes the NFSv4 section in the recording file

options.name: include_paging_space_section
options.description: Includes the Paging Space section in the recording file.

options.name: include_raw_kernal_section
options.description: Includes the RAW Kernel section and the LPAR section in the recording file. If set, it dumps the raw numbers of the corresponding data structure. The memory dump is readable and can be used when the command is recording the data.

options.name: include_sea_vios_section
options.description: Includes the Shared Ethernet adapter (SEA) VIOS sections in the recording file.

options.name: include_top_processes
options.description: Includes the top processes in the output.

options.name: include_top_processes_and_save_cli_agrs
options.displayName: Include Top Processes And Save Cli Agrs
options.description: Includes the top processes in the output and saves the command-line arguments into the UARG section.

options.name: include_top_processes_with_commands
options.description: Includes the top process in the recording with all of the commands of the same name that are added and recorded.

options.name: include_wlm_section
options.description: Includes the WLM sections into the recording file.

options.name: include_wlm_section_with_subclasses
options.description: Includes WLM sections with subclasses in the recording file.

options.name: interval_seconds
options.description: Specifies the interval in seconds between 2 consecutive recording snapshots.

options.name: number_of_snapshots
options.description: Specifies the number snapshots that must be taken by the command. The default value is 10000000 for the NMON command.

options.name: output_path
options.description: Specifies the file name or directory to which the recorded file is to be stored.

options.name: pcpu_details
options.description: Enables or disables recording of Physical CPU (PCPU) sections, which are nothing but metrics that start with PCPU. These metrics are based on Processor Utilization of Resources Register (PURR).

options.name: percentage_of_process_threshold
options.description: Specifies the percentage of process threshold at which the command ignores the TOP processes statistics. The default percentage is 0.1. The command does not save the TOP processes statistics if the process is using less processor than the specified percentage.

options.name: priority
options.description: Specifies the priority of the nmon command that is running. A value of -20 means important. A value of 20 means not important. Only root user can specify a negative value.

options.name: report_thread_level_stats
options.description: Reports thread level statistics.

options.name: restrict_commands_in_listing
options.description: Restricts the process that are listed

options.name: runname
options.description: Specifies the value for the runname field written to the spreadsheet file. By default, the value is the hostname.

options.name: save_to_dir
options.description: Changes the directory before the command saves the data to a file.

options.name: scpu_details
options.description: Enables or disables recording of Scaled CPU (SCPU) sections, which are nothing but metrics that start with SCPU. These metrics are based on Scaled Processor Utilization of Resources Register (SPURR).

options.name: sensible_recording_for_one_day
options.description: Specifies the sensible spreadsheet recording for duration of 1 day for capacity planning. By default, the recording is done every 900 seconds for 96 times. This flag is equivalent to -ft -s 900 -c 96.

options.name: sensible_recording_for_one_hr
options.description: Specifies the sensible spreadsheet recording for duration of 1 hour for capacity planning. By default, the recording is done every 30 seconds for 120 times. This flag is equivalent to -ft -s 30 -c 120.

options.name: sensible_recording_one_day_without_top
options.displayName: Sensible Recording One Day Without Top
options.description: Specifies the sensible spreadsheet recording for duration of 1day for capacity planning. By default, the recording is done every 900 seconds for 96 times. This flag is equivalent to -f -s 900 -c 96.

options.name: skip_JFS_section
options.description: Skips the JFS section.

options.name: skip_disk_config
options.description: Skips the Disk Configuration section.

options.name: skip_ess_config
options.description: Skips the ESS Configuration section.

options.name: spreadsheet_output
options.description: Specifies that the output is in spreadsheet format. By default, the command takes 288 snapshots of system data with an interval of 300 seconds between each snapshot. The name of the output file is in the format of hostname_YYMMDD_HHMM.nmon.

options.name: timestamp_size
options.description: Specifies the size of timestamp (Tnnnn) to be recorded. The timestamp is recorded in the .csv file. The value of the number parameter ranges from 4 through 16, for NMON analyzer, use the values 4 or 8.

options.name: use_greenwhich_time
options.description: Uses Greenwich mean time (GMT) instead of local time. This method is helpful when you compare nmon files from many LPAR of 1 system for processor view but the LPAR are in different time zones.
